name: audio-asset-pipeline
description: Two-mode (auto/manual) game BGM and sound-effect pipeline driven by locally run models (ACE-Step 1.5, Stable Audio 3, MiniMax-Music3). Text-prompt and reference-audio conditioning, seeded candidate iteration with approval gates, loop post-processing (seamless loop points, LUFS normalization, WAV/OGG export), and a measured review stage with spectrograms. Commands: /init-audio, /se, /bgm, /approve, /post-audio, /review-audio, /check-audio, /setup-audio, /audio-info.
